text: If he intends to remain always a manual labourer, then he should forget about his work when the whistle blows, but if he intends to go forward and do anything, the whistle is only a signal to start thinking over the day's work in order to discover how it might be done better.
author: Henry Ford
reference: My Life and Work (with Samuel Crowther)
locator: Chapter II, What I Learned About Business
